column1: # REQ-054 (n=4): does K-Maxwell need multiple memory timescales, or does one age-matched EMA suffice?
# age-matched single-EMA decay = A(t)/(1+A(t)), A(t)=K-Maxwell scheduled avg age (validated 57.96->26.0, matches spec 58->26).
# => K-Maxwell BEATS the age-matched single EMA by ~0.0097 in every seed (>>~2e-4 noise). The benefit is the
#    MULTI-TIMESCALE MIXTURE (multi-pole expressivity), NOT merely the scheduled average memory age. A single EMA
#    with the identical age schedule does not reproduce K-Maxwell. age schedule validated 58->26 (AgeMatchedEmaMuon).
